name_zh: 萨迦班智达/桑耶寺主持：藏传佛法治理与经教辩经
name_en: Sakya Pandita/Samye Abbots: Tibetan Buddhist Governance & Doctrinal Dialectics
description_zh: 萨迦班智达 (1182-1251) 以《理门宝鬘》《辨三誓论》确立萨迦派教法体系，受蒙古帝国册封为吐蕃教主，建立"萨迦政权"——政教合一的藩属治理模式；桑耶寺 (779建立) 历代堪布主持辩经度僧制（拉让巴格西），通过逻辑辩证选拔人才、仲裁教义争端，形成独特的"经教辩经"治理范式。核心机制：辩经即司法、戒律即宪法、寺院即行政单元、上师相授即权力传承。
description_en: Sakya Pandita (1182-1251) established Sakya doctrinal system via 'Gateway to Logic' and 'Three Vows Discrimination', appointed by Mongol Empire as Tibet's religious ruler, creating 'Sakya Regime'—theocratic vassal governance model; Samye Monastery (founded 779) successive abbots presided over dialectical debate for monastic ordination (Lharampa Geshe), using logical dialectics for talent selection and doctrinal dispute resolution, forming unique 'doctrinal dialectics' governance paradigm. Core mechanism: debate = judiciary, vinaya = constitution, monastery = administrative unit, guru transmission = power succession.
reason_zh: 藏传佛教非单纯信仰，而是以辩证逻辑为核心的治理技术：辩经度僧=人才选拔标准化、寺院网络=行政覆盖、转世系统=权力平稳传递。M160 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉协商)、M160 藏传佛法治理(辩证法为核心)，核心在于"逻辑辩证即治理算法"。
reason_en: Tibetan Buddhism is not mere faith but governance technology centered on dialectical logic: dialectical debate for ordination = standardized talent selection, monastery network = administrative coverage, reincarnation system = smooth power transfer. M160 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultative) and M160 Tibetan Buddhist governance (dialectics as core), core: "dialectical logic as governance algorithm".
steps_zh: 建立经教体系：班智达《释量论》注释确立因明逻辑为教法基石
辩经选拔人才：拉让巴格西考试，逻辑辩证胜出者获最高学位与职位
寺院行政管理：萨迦/哲蚌/色拉三大寺网络覆盖吐藏区，堪布即地方长官
政教协同传承：活佛转世系统（达赖/班禅）确保权力平稳跨代际传递
steps_en: Establish doctrinal system: Pandita's Pramanavarttika commentary establishes Buddhist logic as doctrinal foundation
Dialectical debate for talent selection: Lharampa Geshe exam, dialectical winners get highest degree & office
Monastery administrative management: Sakya/Drepung/Sera three great monasteries network covers Ü-Tsang, abbots as local governors
Religion-politics synergistic transmission: tulku reincarnation system (Dalai/Panchen) ensures smooth cross-generational power transfer
expected_zh: 高原地区以"辩证逻辑+寺院网络+转世传承"三位一体实现跨族群/跨语言的长期稳定治理，提供宗教即治理技术的独特范式。
expected_en: Plateau region achieves long-term stable governance across ethnicities/languages via trinity of "dialectical logic+monastery network+reincarnation transmission", providing unique paradigm of religion as governance technology.
case_zh: 1244忽必烈册封班智达为吐蕃教主→1260萨迦政权建立→1642古什汗扶持格鲁派→1653顺治册封达赖喇嘛→1951十七条协议，政教模式延续700年。
case_en: 1244 Kublai appoints Pandita as Tibet ruler -> 1260 Sakya Regime established -> 1642 Gushri Khan backs Gelug -> 1653 Shunzhi confirms Dalai Lama -> 1951 17-Point Agreement, theocratic model continues 700 years.
cross_cultural_impact: Buddhist logic influenced Mongol/Yuan law; tulku system model for theocratic succession; Pramana logic in Central Asian curricula
